Done. Here is the honest final state.

## Corrected the two false round-1 claims
1. **Scope claim (b) retracted.** `delivery_lease.go`/`delivery_seal.go`/`backup.go` were mine exclusively — not co-edited. I edited `delivery_lease.go` (preserving main's terminal-map/load-call and c95b missing-anchor guards untouched); `delivery_seal.go` needed no change (the generation store is additive to the seal chain); `backup.go` correctly untouched (below).
2. **"Not wired in" retracted.** `internal/store` now compiles; the transient blocker is gone. The generation store is **wired live and the wired path is focus-tested and passing** — not an unwired primitive.

## Delivered (my exclusive files) — every specific concern addressed
**`delivery_generation.go` (hardened):**
- **Exact commit authority** — the fsynced manifest record *is* the commit; the head is an atomic checkpoint. A complete un-headed tail is adopted; a torn tail is refused and preserved; a head that disagrees with the log (ahead, or wrong root/seq/chain) is refused. Never trusts a conflicting uncommitted root.
- **Bounded startup, not just bounded memory** — root-anchored tail-only recovery via `genHead.LastLen` (O(1) boundary verify), no whole-lifetime manifest scan.
- **`os.Root` head/manifest confinement parity** with the radix pages.
- **Fail-closed I/O poisoning** across all queries.
- **Durable ACK membership + durable terminal membership** (exact identity join, never a blind marker), and a **bounded per-session settled frontier** — `sessionFrontier` is O(1) (one watermark read), advanced amortized-O(1) at settle time; exact under out-of-order settlement.

**`delivery_lease.go` (live wiring, behind default-off `enableDeliveryGenerations`):** open+reconcile under the held lock; `decide` resolves an archived nonce's redelivery to its **original** lease (never re-mints) and continues a dormant/archived session's arrivals densely; lease + ack mirrors on commit (fail-closed); close.

## Test evidence (run through `run.py`, GOMAXPROCS=2, recorded under `runs/`)
| run id | scope | result |
|---|---|---|
| `capacity-integration-gen-03` | generation + radix (36 cases) | **PASS** exit 0 |
| `capacity-integration-wiring-02` | 4 live-wiring cases | **PASS** exit 0 |
| `capacity-integration-regress-01` | journal/cap/radix/generation | **PASS** exit 0, 134 s — no regression, seam off |

(`gen-02` caught a real idempotency bug: the arrival watermark must advance monotonically — fixed.)

## The one thing still gated, with the exact cross-package contract
Enabling the capacity-**freeing** step (compacting settled leases out of the active journal to reclaim the 65536/64 MiB budget) cannot be done from my files: `internal/store/gcrun.go:611` reads the **exact** `delivery-leases.jsonl` as retention roots (∩ `acknowledgedDeliveries()` over the exact `delivery-acks.jsonl`) with **no segment glob**, and the frozen format enforces dense arrivals + identity permanence. So freeing the budget needs **either** store GC to read lease/ack **segments** (`gcrun.go`) **or** a §5.8 format change admitting density gaps — both outside my scope. Until one lands, the seam stays `false`: the reader/writer index is wired and tested; the budget-freeing rollover is not turned on. **Backup:** the generation store is backup-safe by construction (atomic head + append manifest + immutable pages); the watch list needs no change and could not take one without breaking `backupedge_test`'s `len==4` assertion.

Report corrected in place (`delivery-capacity-integration-work.md`: round-2 correction + authoritative API/frontier/wiring section prepended; round-1 body preserved). No git/config/commits.
